held_out_split.witnesses: The stated references evaluated with two's-complement wrapping i64 arithmetic are the only held-out expected values. Every case is re-admitted through typed-chunk/1; the library contains only the two source task records and no target id, target body, target answer, or evaluator state.
held_out_split.split_rule: All twelve input triples per task are withheld from library admission and retrieval-index construction. The transfer fixture contains target task ids and their reference outputs only at the consumer-check boundary.

arms.name: no_library
arms.purpose: measure refusal when retrieval has no procedure candidates

arms.name: frozen_hand_library
arms.purpose: same two retained source bodies, constructed as explicit hand-library records rather than acquired producer records

arms.name: accumulated_learned_library
arms.purpose: append producer records in separate generations and evaluate each fixed sweep

arms.name: size_matched_nontransfer
arms.acquisition_order: admit the lexicographically ordered selected pair one record per generation, matching the accumulated-learned archive shape
arms.selection: Among all two-task subsets whose source task has an I64 x I64 -> I64 interface and no precondition, select the pair with the smallest absolute difference in canonical encoded library byte length from the two-entry accumulated library, with both pairs admitted in two successive generations. Ties use lexicographic task-id order. No held-out case, target output, or transfer result may influence selection. Require an absolute size difference <= 10%; otherwise report the arm unavailable and do not claim a size-matched comparison.
arms.purpose: control for the same retrieval-entry count and approximately equal serialized library size using different producer tasks

success_threshold.learned_transfer: All three held-out cases pass for both composed tasks at each of all four seeds (8/8 seed-task cells, 24/24 cases).
success_threshold.no_runtime_proposer_or_teacher: Exactly zero proposer_calls and teacher_calls in every arm/seed; any attempted call must return a refusal and invalidates the transfer claim.
success_threshold.control: Report all control outcomes without changing the success threshold or selecting a different non-transfer pair after inspecting outcomes.

fixed_measurements: acquisition count and task count per arm and seed
generation count and restart identity equality
record count, canonical encoded library bytes, and identity-manifest digest
retrieval query count, examined-entry total, maximum examined entries, and measured retrieval-only monotonic nanoseconds
passed/total composed tasks and passed/total held-out examples
break-even invocation count per arm/seed or null with an explicit reason
measurement_limits: The #116 producer artifact is fixed input to this evaluation; synthesis is not run during any arm.

Composition orders are frozen by the target task descriptions. Retrieval returns identities only; every composed source is freshly prepared and re-admitted by the ordinary checker and typed-chunk/1 fixtures.
No result claims lifelong learning, universal transfer, a speedup, amortized break-even, proof of source-to-graph correspondence, or a model-generated plan.
A passing bounded Rust execution is implementation evidence, not a proof. Producer certificates and this lane's typed-chunk re-admission remain separate evidence classes.
receipt_requirement: Run exactly once from a clean committed source tree, bind that source commit, criteria SHA-256, producer receipt SHA-256, selected control pair and raw command output; commit a new dated receipt separately.
